summary: Iter89 — Guest (logged-out) direct-to-Stripe checkout tested end-to-end. Backend endpoints (single=cs_test, premium/vip=cs_live, invalid=400, unknown session=404, fresh unpaid poll) all pass (8/8). CRITICAL E2E: completed a real cs_test single-report purchase with test card 4242… → /welcome auto-created guest_checkout account → password form → auto-login → /upload; verified in mongo: auth_provider=guest_checkout, prepaid_uploads=1, reset token used=True. Login with the set password works (200 + access_token). Re-poll after password set returns setup_token=null (single-use consumed). Second purchase with SAME email surfaced guest-welcome-existing panel (no password form, Log in button) and incremented prepaid_uploads to 2. /welcome without guest_session shows guest-welcome-error + retry. Logged-out Premium landing CTA redirects to checkout.stripe.com with a cs_live session (not paid). Regression: /api/auth/signup + /api/auth/login for a new normal user OK; admin login + /payments/subscribe (authenticated) unchanged. All disposable users, txns and reset tokens cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 14,987 lines — well past the >700 line threshold; strongly recommend modularizing (payments/, auth/, reports/ routers).
GuestWelcomePage polls every 2s up to 15 attempts (~30s) — acceptable, but consider showing a subtle spinner/countdown so users don't refresh mid-flow.

In /payments/guest/status the second Stripe SDK arming (`StripeCheckout(api_key=...)` inside the handler purely to re-arm the module) is a bit fragile — a small helper `_arm_test_stripe()` symmetric to `_arm_real_stripe()` would be clearer.
test_credentials: Admin admin@elitescout.com / Admin@2026!Elite (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Disposable guest user (deleted after test): guestbuy_1786306434@test.com / Test@12345.
seed_data_creation: Two real Stripe test-mode single-report cs_test sessions were completed with card 4242 4242 4242 4242 for guestbuy_1786306434@test.com. Both txns + user + reset token DELETED post-test. 11 stale dangling unpaid guest txns from prior iterations (created by fresh-session status tests, user_id=None) were also purged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Direct-to-Stripe guest checkout flow is production-ready in the preview: single-report end-to-end confirmed (test-mode), Premium/VIP cs_live URL shape confirmed (never pay these — real money). The pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_iter89_guest_checkout.py can be reused as a regression suite. Disposable users pattern: emails starting with 'guestbuy_' or 'TEST_' should be cleaned by future agents via db.users + db.payment_transactions + db.password_reset_tokens deletes.
